documents.title: Archive recovery
documents.text: The archive service keeps deleted notebooks for 21 days. Restore a notebook from the Recovery drawer. Restoring does not restore former sharing permissions.

documents.title: Beacon heartbeat
documents.text: A beacon reports its heartbeat every 45 seconds. After four consecutive missed heartbeats, the console labels it silent. A silent label does not disable the beacon.

documents.title: Cargo inspection
documents.text: Incoming cargo must wait in the amber bay until inspection is complete. Inspectors stamp approved crates with a blue triangle. An orange circle means inspection is pending.

documents.title: Drone charging
documents.text: Survey drones charge at the west dock. A full charging cycle takes 80 minutes. Drones cannot start a survey with less than 35 percent battery.

documents.title: Export bundles
documents.text: A report export bundle includes CSV tables and a JSON manifest. Bundles expire after 72 hours. The manifest stores SHA-256 checksums for every included table.

documents.title: Frost sensor
documents.text: The frost sensor is calibrated with a silver reference plate. Recalibrate it every 30 days. A blinking violet light means calibration is overdue.

documents.title: Garden humidity
documents.text: The seed garden humidity target is 64 percent. If humidity exceeds 70 percent, open the roof vent for 12 minutes. The soil moisture reading is a separate measurement.

documents.title: Harbor visitor passes
documents.text: Harbor visitor passes remain valid for nine hours. Visitors collect a pass at the east kiosk. A visitor pass does not authorize access to the engine deck.

documents.title: Iris emergency access
documents.text: When the Iris door loses network connectivity, enter the local access code 5826. The mechanical override key is stored in locker C7. The local code is fictional training data.

documents.title: Junction message queue
documents.text: The junction queue retries a failed delivery up to five times. Each retry waits 18 seconds. After the fifth failed retry, the message enters the copper dead-letter queue.

documents.title: Keel backup policy
documents.text: Keel configuration backups run every six hours. The station keeps 28 backup snapshots. Restoring a snapshot requires the maintenance role and restarts the routing service.

documents.title: Lantern outage procedure
documents.text: During a lantern outage, switch the corridor controller to manual mode. The reserve lamp lasts 150 minutes. A steady green indicator confirms that the reserve lamp is active.

documents.title: Mirror synchronization
documents.text: Mirror replicas synchronize every 14 minutes. A replica more than 40 minutes behind is marked stale. Stale replicas remain readable but cannot serve verification requests.

documents.title: Nova alert routing
documents.text: Nova critical alerts go to the on-call navigator. Warning alerts go to the observation team. A critical alert must be acknowledged within seven minutes.

documents.title: Orbit session security
documents.text: Orbit sessions expire after 25 minutes of inactivity. The maximum active session duration is ten hours. Resetting a password immediately revokes every existing session.

documents.title: Prism sample storage
documents.text: Prism mineral samples are stored at 8 degrees Celsius. Each sample requires a white tamper seal. Samples with broken seals must be moved to quarantine shelf Q4.

documents.title: Quartz service limits
documents.text: The Quartz lookup service accepts 90 requests per minute per client. Requests above that limit receive status 429. A client should wait 20 seconds before trying again.

documents.title: Rivet tool checkout
documents.text: Rivet torque tools must be returned within three hours. Borrowers leave their badge in the red tray. Tools with a damaged grip go to the repair desk instead of the tool rack.

documents.title: Garden soil moisture
documents.text: The seed garden soil moisture target is 42 percent. A dry soil warning triggers after ten minutes below 35 percent. Soil sensors do not measure humidity.

documents.title: Engine deck passes
documents.text: Engine deck contractor passes expire after four hours. Contractors collect them at the north security desk. Harbor visitor passes are not accepted on the engine deck.

documents.title: Iris network enrollment
documents.text: The Iris network enrollment code is 7319. This code enrolls a controller in the network and cannot open a door. Enrollment is performed from the network console.

documents.title: Reserve lamp charging
documents.text: The reserve lamp needs 200 minutes to recharge fully. Charging uses the wall connector in the corridor. A full charge lasts a shorter time when the lamp is in use.

documents.title: Quartz bulk service
documents.text: The Quartz bulk service accepts 12 batches per hour. Batch jobs return status 202 when queued. This service has a separate quota from the lookup service.

documents.title: Rivet calibration
documents.text: Rivet torque tools are calibrated every 60 days. Calibration happens at the instrument bench. The repair desk handles physical damage, not routine calibration.
